verdict.rationale: Modal ships an official Python SDK with a documented Sandbox API reference covering exec, logs, probes, snapshots, networking and resource parameters, plus maintained release notes. Official JS and Go SDKs are also documented with Sandbox code examples, and a community builder shipped runners on Modal Sandboxes. Missing for 10: JS/Go SDKs cover only "some" platform resources (parity with Python unproven), and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality specifically.
